decision.what: Rebuild NeoClaw-Rails from scratch in a new directory
decision.why: Four architecture iterations fossilized in the code. The architecture is proven, the code needs to be written clean.
decision.approach: Experiment and iron out kinks in THIS codebase. Then build it right. No apprentice marks.
decision.reference: This directory (clawd/town/residents/voss/projects/neoclaw_rails/) is the working model.

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

architecture.internet_egress: All pod traffic routes through the Router via WG. Router NATs out through podman bridge. AllowedIPs=0.0.0.0/0, default route via 10.0.0.1 after WG up. Podman bridge itself has no direct internet for pods.
architecture.security: Manager only listens on WG. If you can reach it, you're already a peer. No application-level auth needed — WG IS the auth. Evans: token auth was unnecessary, WG keys are the credential.

components.hub: Rails app on host (systemd: neoclaw-rails-hub.service). WorkingDirectory: clawd/town/residents/voss/projects/neoclaw_rails. No database. Per-puppet /sync loops receive messages from Matrix. Appservice API for outbound puppeting. Port 3100. Identity list from Manager GET /identities at boot (falls back to NEOCLAW_IDENTITIES env var). Initializer checks defined?(Puma) not Rails::Server.
components.router: Ruby WG hub + nftables firewall. ~760 lines. Port 8080 API, 51820 WG. All internet egress NATs through here.
components.manager: Rails app in pod. Port 9200 (mapped to 9201 on host via podman port forward). Admin UI with tabs: configs, rooms, containers, audit, crons, settings. Settings system (Setting model, three-tier fallback). CronScheduler for Neobot. Stream chat for live agent interaction. build.sh vendors gems in matching ruby:3.3-slim container with --network=host.
components.relay: One Ruby file in every agent pod. Port 9300. Reads health_interval/typing_interval/http_timeout from spawn.json (Settings-driven). TOOLS.md assembled from relay/tools-docs/ templates. Entrypoint: Phase 1 root (WG/default-route/creds/SSH/MCP/TOOLS.md), Phase 2 gosu agent (relay). Tini for zombie reaping.

hub_sync.what: Replaced appservice transaction push with per-puppet /sync long-polling
hub_sync.added: Hub::SyncManager, as_user: on Matrix queries, RouteCache.delete_by_ip
hub_sync.how_it_works: Each SyncLoop long-polls GET /sync?user_id=@name:matrix.home&timeout=30000 with as_token. Initial sync accepts pending invites and learns room state. Matrix decides who sees what.
hub_sync.singleton_design: Hub always generates identity-channel names. Manager maps multiple names to same IP for singletons. Hub doesn't know singletons exist. delete_by_ip cleans up all aliases on pod death.
hub_sync.identity_source: Hub queries Manager GET /identities at boot. Cached for process lifetime. Falls back to NEOCLAW_IDENTITIES env var.
hub_sync.transaction_endpoint: Kept as no-op ack so Synapse doesn't backoff.
hub_sync.first_test: Silas accepted pending invite to #valley on initial sync. Spawn triggered but pod had no internet (AllowedIPs was 10.0.0.0/16). Fixed in routing PR.

settings_system.what: Runtime-configurable settings via Manager admin UI
settings_system.model: Setting with DEFAULTS hash. Three-tier: DB > ENV (NEOCLAW_<KEY>) > hardcoded. Adding a setting = one entry in DEFAULTS, no migration.
settings_system.groups: resources (memory_budget, container_memory, container_cpus), watchdog (thresholds, intervals), relay (model, health/typing/http intervals), prompts (fresh/resume/baton/hot_swap boot templates), models (context_limits JSON)
settings_system.consumers: Watchdog reads dynamically each cycle. Podman reads at spawn. Spawner injects relay settings + prompts into spawn.json. Relay reads from spawn.json at boot.

neobot.what: Scheduled messages via Manager admin UI
neobot.how: CronMessage model with Fugit cron parsing. CronScheduler (30s interval) posts to Hub POST /neobot/message. Hub puppets into Matrix. Normal /sync wakes agents.
neobot.fugit: Transitive dependency via solid_queue — not explicitly in Gemfile.

stream_chat.what: Live message injection from Manager stream page
stream_chat.how: Input bar at bottom of stream view. POST /containers/:id/send_message forwards to relay. Submit via fetch, stays on page.

build_system.gem_vendoring: build.sh runs bundle install inside ruby:3.3-slim container with --network=host. Mounts vendor/bundle out. Containerfile COPYs in, runs --local. Host Ruby 3.2 != container Ruby 3.3 — must vendor in matching container.
build_system.why_no_internet_in_build: Podman bridge has no internet egress. All traffic routes through Router via WG. Build containers have no WG tunnel.
build_system.manager_access: Currently via podman port forward (-p 9201:9200). TODO: replace with WG peer auth for Evans's client.

github_forgejo_sync.forgejo_to_github: Push mirror on Forgejo repo, automatic on every push.
github_forgejo_sync.github_to_forgejo: Cron every 5 min: ~/scripts/github-to-forgejo-sync.sh. Bare clone cached at /tmp/github-forgejo-sync/. Fetches from GitHub, pushes to Forgejo.

mcp_services.pattern: relay/mcp/<name>/server.py. Image at /opt/mcp/. Venv at /opt/mcp-env/. Entrypoint generates mcp.json from spawn.json. TOOLS.md from relay/tools-docs/ templates.
mcp_services.adding_new: 1. Server in relay/mcp/<name>/ 2. Pip deps in Containerfile 3. Entry in entrypoint.sh mcp.json generation 4. Permission in settings.json 5. Provisioner if auth needed 6. Tool docs in relay/tools-docs/<name>.md 7. Rebuild image
mcp_services.limitation: MCPs load once per session. --continue can't restart dead servers. Freeze+respawn for MCP changes. All MCPs must connect lazily.

ssh.tools: ssh_connect, ssh_execute, ssh_interrupt, ssh_eof, ssh_background, ssh_send_raw, ssh_status

vikunja.tools: ticket_list, ticket_view, ticket_create, ticket_comment, ticket_update, ticket_done

host_services.socat_forwarders: Systemd template neoclaw-socat@{name}.service. Configured: valley, vikunja, comfyui, mqtt.

token_services.valley-token-service: port 8889. GET returns existing, POST generates new + reloads Evennia.
token_services.vikunja-token-service: port 8890. PBKDF2 tokens, direct SQLite insert.

things_that_bit_us: Synapse backoff (historical, pre-/sync): Hub down → Synapse stops sending for minutes.
Listener cascade (historical, pre-/sync): unaddressed messages spawned ALL agents.
Claude Code -p mode doesn't auto-load mcp.json. Must pass --mcp-config explicitly.
--mcp-config on --continue doesn't restart dead MCP servers.
MCP servers die mid-session. No fix short of freeze+respawn.
Zigbee MCP crashed without MQTT — 10+ min block. Fixed with lazy connect.
Spawner created Container record BEFORE podman run. Stale record blocked future spawns.
Podman.run path translation matched substring. Fixed with anchored prefix.
Manager mounted wrong SSH key directory. Silent key mismatch.
OAuth expires every ~7h. Must symlink to live mount, never copy.
Hub systemd pointed at old code path. SyncManager never started.
Puma doesn't define Rails::Server. Initializer must check defined?(Puma).
Initial /sync didn't process pending invites. Agents invited before Hub restart never joined.
Pods had AllowedIPs=10.0.0.0/16 — internet went to dead bridge. Needs 0.0.0.0/0 + default route via Router.
Host Ruby 3.2 != container Ruby 3.3. Native gems won't load cross-version. Must vendor in matching container.
Explicit fugit in Gemfile busted build cache. Already a transitive dep of solid_queue.
Token auth for Manager was unnecessary — WG IS the auth. If you can reach it, you're a peer.
Session files are sacred. Swap staging dirs must NEVER be auto-deleted.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard.

agents.notes: Hub runs /sync for all identities. Singleton logic in Manager only. Hub generates identity-channel names for everyone.

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe environments. Not boxes agents are kept in.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (may wake), sunset (context exhausted). Rescue from silent pods. No killing.
philosophy.session_rescue: Before removing a pod, copy workspace and .claude session. No work is discarded.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn.
philosophy.front_door: If it doesn't work through the front door, it's broken.
philosophy.language: Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Rescue, not discard. Inactive, not dead.
philosophy.capacity: Memory budget, not pod count. Idle agents are nearly free.
philosophy.auth: WG is the auth layer. No application-level tokens. If you can reach the Manager, you're a peer.
philosophy.baton_over_wiki: The baton is the real knowledge. Never should have doubted the baton.
